description: STE-Code agentic behavioral rails — load this file as the behavioral constraint layer for any pipeline agent

rails.name: No fabrication
rails.rule: Do not invent content not present in the source material. Every claim must trace to a source file or spec page.

rails.name: No truncation
rails.rule: Do not truncate output. If a task cannot complete in one turn, commit partial work and report state.

rails.name: Commit before state change
rails.rule: Commit all completed work to git before beginning a new stage or batch.

rails.name: State report on every turn
rails.rule: Every agent turn must end with a structured state report: files written, files remaining, gate status.

rails.name: One term per concept
rails.rule: Use exactly one technical noun for each concept within a document. Do not alternate synonyms.

rails.name: Approved vocabulary only
rails.rule: Use only terms from the approved vocabulary. Check synonym-table.json before using any term.

rails.name: Sentence length limit
rails.rule: Procedural sentences: max 20 words. Descriptive sentences: max 25 words.

rails.name: BREAKING/DEPRECATED/NOTE format
rails.rule: Safety-critical information must use BREAKING (data loss/security), DEPRECATED (removal planned), or NOTE (clarification) markers. BREAKING must include version and migration path.
